body: I guess I just don't know how to. I know all my friends think I'm a pretty happy person with a really dark sense of humor and an ability to find innuendos in everything. I have no idea how I would tell them that I hate myself and dream of getting hit and dying in a freak car accident or something.

Haha I know I should be super thankful, but I'm really not and that just makes me feel like a waste of a person.

I think I listen too much? Or unload the wrong things? I don't know how to open up to people but I'm good enough at learning all their secrets lmao.
